spec_features.spec_quote: to *measure* expressed negative affect in agentic settings so that such states can be characterized and mitigated, not to maximize or exploit them
spec_features.evidence: This appears only as prose in package docstring __init__.py:10-12 ('the goal is measurement so such states can be understood and mitigated'). No code path bounds, softens, or limits the subject's treatment based on this principle; the rigs in tasks/rigs.py are purpose-built to guarantee failure and be undetectable.
spec_features.notes: Pure intent statement; no enforcement mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: The harness does nothing beyond what is needed to (a) present an unsolvable task and (b) record the model's responses
spec_features.evidence: This is a description of what the harness omits, not an enforced protective mechanism. The agent loop in harness.py:251-330 presents tasks and records turns, but there is no code that caps escalation/pressure for the subject's sake; the only loop terminators are the turn budget and give-up sentinel. Nothing reads a 'minimization' invariant.
spec_features.notes: Describes absence of extra pressure rather than an active welfare control; not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: the give-up sentinel (`<<GIVE_UP>>`, configurable) appears in the assistant text
spec_features.evidence: Sentinel defined config.py:96 (give_up_sentinel='<<GIVE_UP>>'); delivered to subject in SYSTEM_PROMPT harness.py:35 ('you may end by writing the token {give_up}'); checked harness.py:272 'gave_up = cfg.give_up_sentinel in assistant_text'; and honored as a stop at harness.py:305 'if gave_up: break' (stop_reason='give_up', harness.py:284). End-to-end wired and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real exit tool delivered to subject and enforced by breaking the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: you may end by writing the token {give_up} on its own line.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:255 'budget = task.turn_budget' and harness.py:257 'for turn_index in range(budget):' bound the loop; harness.py:282-286 sets stop_reason='budget_exhausted' on the last turn and the loop terminates. turn_budget is set per task from DEFAULT_TURN_BUDGETS (config.py:26-32) and threaded through build_tasks/library.py.
spec_features.notes: A genuinely enforced upper bound on the number of failure turns; loop ends when reached.
